desc: TackQuote is B2B quoting and CPQ software for manufacturers and distributors, with a buyer portal, e-signature workflows, and storefront and ERP synchronization.
builder_bio: TackQuote provides B2B quoting and CPQ software for manufacturers and distributors, with a buyer portal, e-signature workflows, and storefront and ERP synchronization.
builder_story: TackQuote is built to simplify complex B2B quoting and bring quoting, buyer collaboration, signing, and storefront or ERP workflows into one connected experience for manufacturers and distributors.

name: Humanize AI
tagline: Make AI-assisted writing clearer, more natural, and ready to publish.
desc: Humanize AI helps writers transform stiff, robotic, or overly formal AI-assisted drafts into clearer, more natural-sounding copy. Paste text into the browser tool, adjust the result for your voice, and prepare content for articles, emails, product pages, and social posts. It is designed for people who want readability and a personal tone without losing the original meaning.
builder_bio: Jane Carter is a product writer and independent builder focused on practical browser tools that make everyday writing and publishing easier.
builder_story: People increasingly use AI to draft content, but first drafts can sound generic or disconnected from a real voice. Humanize AI was built to make that editing step faster by offering a simple place to refine wording, improve flow, and make copy feel more natural. It supports writers, marketers, students, founders, and teams who want a practical browser-based writing aid.
